newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan refineries unaffected by Kyushu quake.
newsitem.headline: Japan refineries unaffected by Kyushu quake.

text.p: Refinery operations have not been affected by a strong earthquake that shook Japan's southernmost main island of Kyushu on Tuesday morning, refinery officials said.
"Nothing was affected at our plant. Everything is running as usual," said an official at Kyushu Oil Co's 136,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) Oita refinery on the island.

Japan's Meteorological Agency said the quake, which struck at 7.18 a.m. (2218 GMT Monday), registered five on Japan's seven-point scale in the city of Miyazaki in southern Kyushu. A five can violently shake houses.

Operations at Taiyo Oil Co's 89,000 bpd Kikuma refinery, Seibu Oil Co's 120,000 bpd Yamaguchi plant, and Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd's 120,000 bpd Tokuyama refinery, which are located near Kyushu, were also unaffected by the quake, refinery officials said.
